_comment: CANONICAL FAST H3 GRAPH — adapted verbatim from the founder's own ComfyUI export MiniMax_H3_r2v_int8_MMH3Cache_adapted_api.json (founder-tested on the 5090, 2026-08-05). The model chain is UNETLoader(minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot) -> PathchSageAttentionKJ(auto, allow_compile false) -> MiniMaxH3Cache(resuse_threshold 0.03 — that misspelling is the node's real input name — active 15%-90%, max_steps 1) -> ModelPreviewOverrideKJ -> BasicGuider. Sampling is res_multistep + the simple scheduler at 20 steps, guidance-distilled (BasicGuider, no CFG), so there is NO negative conditioning input: negatives must be written as prose in the prompt. NOTE BasicScheduler deliberately takes its model from the SAGE-ATTENTION node, not from the cache — sigmas do not need the cache wrapper. This graph REPLACES the earlier nvfp4 + EasyCache/Spectrum graphs. AUDIO LATENT FIX, do not regress it: VAEDecodeAudio reads SamplerCustomAdvanced output index 1 (the AUDIO latent). Every graph before this one wired index 0 — the VIDEO latent — into the audio VAE. ALMOST EVERYTHING HERE IS OVERRIDDEN AT RUN TIME by dhee-runner-minimax-h3 from the node's bundle.json config: prompt, the whole reference-image group, width, height, length, ref_image_size, steps, scheduler, sampler_name, noise_seed, fps, SaveVideo.filename_prefix, and every MiniMaxH3Cache parameter (cache / cacheThreshold / cacheStart / cacheEnd / cacheMaxSteps). Editing those values HERE alone changes nothing — change the bundle.json config. The values below are kept in sync with it so this file still reads as the truth about what actually runs. Set cache:false in config to A/B the cache: the runner deletes the node and rewires downstream model consumers to its upstream.
_comment_bundle: illustrated_story_h3: 1344x768 is H3's NATIVE LANDSCAPE geometry (768 short edge, capped 768x1344, /32) and a deliberate cost decision — 2.58x the pixels of the stock ComfyUI template's 0.4MP, 178s vs 68s for a 5s/124-frame clip. Accepted because at 480p a full-body character resolves the face to too few pixels and the identity plates stop doing their job. length 362 = 15.08s at 24fps, the top of H3's trained range; the runner derives the real length per section from the dialogue and snaps it to the 17k+5 grid.
_comment_refs: Reference images: ONE placeholder LoadImage (h3Ref0) wired in the DOTTED autogrow form the runner itself emits. The runner deletes every ref_image_*/ref_images.* key and rebuilds one h3Ref{i} LoadImage per uploaded reference, so the count here is irrelevant. The founder's export ships two demo plates (ref_woman_00033.png / ref_man_00034.png) that would be left dangling and point at files no dhee project uploads — dropped on purpose.
_comment_encode: SaveVideo encode is EXPLICIT, not 'auto'. With codec:auto ComfyUI's defaults produced 3.5-4.4 Mbps h264 at 720p24, which visibly blocks on fast motion — measured on a rain/neon rooftop chase where nearly every pixel changes every frame, the worst case for a low bitrate. codec is a nested COMFY_DYNAMICCOMBO_V3: the selected key goes on the input and its own fields arrive as DOTTED sub-keys, nesting one level deeper for `encoding` (codec=h264, codec.encoding=re-encode, codec.encoding.crf=15). CRF 15 against a default of 23 (lower is better, range 0-51). This is a genuine quality gain rather than a re-encode of existing damage: CreateVideo hands SaveVideo RAW FRAMES, so this is the FIRST encode — 'encoding: auto' only passes a stream through when one already exists, which is not the case downstream of a VAEDecode. The founder's raw export ships format/codec 'auto'; that is the one thing here deliberately NOT taken verbatim.
_comment_unet: Staged unet sizes on the box: pruned_nvfp4 11,944 MB, nvfp4_full 17,876 MB, pruned_int8_convrot 19,995 MB. int8_convrot is the largest and is still the founder's call — in-flight VRAM is pinned at ~31.6 of 32 GiB at EVERY clip length regardless (ComfyUI keeps the 14,956 MB text encoder on CPU by default), so unet size is not the memory dial. History: pruned_nvfp4 -> nvfp4_full (measured 17-18% faster, 141s vs 169s at 124f and 334s vs 407s at 226f) -> pruned_int8_convrot with MiniMaxH3Cache + sage attention, this graph.
